text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, I visited a flea market in 
the neighboring town with Chrono Genesis, 
which mostly sold antique goods.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of these items carries a 
sense of history, doesn't it? ...Ah, this 
is—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A vinyl record with an Umamusume on the 
cover... It seems to be a live race 
commentary recording.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, every single one is a 
legendary race... ...Yeah, I'm buying 
this.
choice_data_list: Can you play the record?
Can you play the record?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No, that's impossible, but... Even so, I 
want to keep it close at hand.
choice_data_list: レコード、再生できるのか？
レコード、再生できるの？
choice_data_list_en: Can you play that record?
Can that record be played?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"From an era when recording media weren't 
abundant, the culture of immersing oneself 
in the races... is historically 
invaluable."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Her heart fluttered at vintage items 
related to racing. ...I felt that if I 
could understand that feeling, I might be 
able to understand her better."
choice_data_list:
I'd love if you taught me about the charm 
of vintage stuff too.

I want you to teach me about the charm of 
vintage things too.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...? But, I only talk about it because 
I love it, so..."
choice_data_list: 俺にも、年代物の魅力を教えてほしい
私にも、年代物の魅力を教えてほしいな
choice_data_list_en: I want you to teach me the charm of vintage items, too.
I'd like you to show me what makes vintage items so special too.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...I-I understand. If it's just a little 
bit.
choice_data_list: むしろ好きなだけ語ってほしい！
choice_data_list_en: If anything, I want you to talk about it as much as you like!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I see... These playing cards have 
Umamusume designs on them, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, to think Haiseiko-san is in 
this photo. ...You can really feel the 
passion of that era's racing boom, can't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Wait a moment. That old video game 
over there is...
choice_data_list: Huh, a video game?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It is a game where you become a 
Trainer and aim to conquer all GⅠ races 
alongside your Umamusume.
choice_data_list: えっ、ゲームソフト？
choice_data_list_en: Wait, a video game?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Real-life Umamusume appear in it too, 
so... If you play, you might get a glimpse 
of how the Umamusume of that era were 
perceived...
choice_data_list:
So even that kind of thing interests you, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Relics of the past carry the 
passion that people of those eras felt for 
racing, after all.
choice_data_list: そういうのも興味の対象なんだね
choice_data_list_en: So you're interested in that sort of thing too, huh.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere of the people who loved 
racing back then... These vintage items 
that let you feel that history are what I 
consider true 'historical materials.'
choice_data_list:
I see, learning history through the 
artifacts…

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's an old game, so I'm not sure 
how to play it... Maybe I should ask 
Love-chan for help.
choice_data_list: なるほど、品物から歴史を……
choice_data_list_en: I see, learning history from the items...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, I toured the flea market 
alongside her as she browsed with great 
curiosity...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
E-Excuse me... I seem to have talked a bit 
too much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, everything she talked about was 
utterly fascinating.
choice_data_list:
Maybe I should try buying some 'historical 
records' too.

Maybe I'll buy some "historical materials" 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking around at the stalls, I spotted 
various Umamusume merchandise here and 
there. T-shirts, caps, plushies...
choice_data_list: 俺も、『史料』を買ってみようかな
私も、『史料』を買ってみようかな
choice_data_list_en: Maybe I should buy some of those ãhistorical recordsã too.
Maybe I should buy some "historical records" too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The item that caught my eye the most among 
them... was a pair of glass tumblers 
engraved with the silhouette of an 
Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll go with this one.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: これにしようかな
choice_data_list_en: Maybe I'll go with this.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san. ...Why do you have that 
glass?
choice_data_list:
I wanted to know the "history" behind this 
glass...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The delicately carved silhouette of an 
Umamusume... Its mystical aura gave me the 
feeling that there might be some 
historical background to it.
choice_data_list: このグラスの『歴史』を、知りたくなって
choice_data_list_en: I wanted to learn the 'history' behind this glass.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: W-Was I completely off the mark...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah, no! I was just a little startled...
choice_data_list: も、もしかして見当違いだった……？
choice_data_list_en: W-Was I totally off base...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Because when I looked at that glass, I 
felt the exact same way.
choice_data_list: Huh, Chrono too!?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Judging by these meticulous patterns, it 
was likely made to commemorate 
something... If so, it must be a very 
special glass.
choice_data_list: えっ、クロノも！？
choice_data_list_en: Wait, Chrono too?!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Even I do not know the origins of this 
glass. ...Which is precisely whyâ

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I want to study it. What kind of feelings 
went into making this glass?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To her, this glass seems to be a 
fascinating "historical artifact" as well. 
Fortunately, it's a pair, which means—
choice_data_list: Would you take one of these?
I'd like you to take one.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!? N-No, I couldn't accept this. 
Especially when it's something you picked 
out, Trainer...
choice_data_list: ひとつ、もらってくれないかな
ひとつ、もらってほしいな
choice_data_list_en: Could I have one?
I'd like you to have one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes sparkled as she looked at vintage 
racing memorabilia, and she spoke fondly 
of its history—
choice_data_list: だからこそ、受け取ってほしい
choice_data_list_en: That is precisely why I want you to have this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was precisely because she was there 
that I, too, wanted to learn the racing 
history engraved upon this glass.
choice_data_list:
This is to thank you for showing me the 
charm of "historical materials."

This is a thank-you for showing me the 
charm of "historical materials."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: N-No way... You don't need to thank me.
choice_data_list: 『史料』の魅力を教えてくれた、お礼だ
『史料』の魅力を教えてくれた、お礼だよ
choice_data_list_en: This is my thanks for showing me the charm of historical records.
This is my thanks for showing me how wonderful historical records can be.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...! ...Trainer...
choice_data_list: 次は『史料』の調べ方を教えてほしいんだ
次は『史料』の調べ方を教えてほしいな
choice_data_list_en: Next time, I want you to teach me how to look up historical records.
Next time, I'd like you to teach me how to look up historical records.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, understood. If I will suffice, I'd 
be glad to.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. I wonder what kind of history 
this glass has witnessed...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, truly. ...Um, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Let us unravel history together.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I'll look into it with everything 
I've got!
Yeah, I'll do my best to look into it!

To me, you're my teacher when it comes to 
racing history.
To me, you're a teacher of racing history.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Let us unravel history together.

うん、一生懸命調べてみるよ！

私にとって貴方はレース史の先生だね

Yeah, I'll look into it with everything I've got!

text_block_list.text:

うん、一生懸命調べてみるよ！

私にとって貴方はレース史の先生だね

Yeah, I'll look into it with everything I've got!
To me, you're a teacher of racing history.
To me, you're like a teacher of racing history.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'll review the literature as well... Let 
us discuss this glass together.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-Teacher...? No, that's an exaggeration. 
I just really love the history of racing, 
that's all.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Still, if you ever find yourself 
interested in historical records again... 
please feel free to ask me questions, 
okay?
